name: agent-capability-self-report
prompt: What agents and model choices do you have access to in this harness? AGENT_CAPABILITY_SELF_REPORT_MARKER
config_toml:
model_provider = "local-fixture"
model_reasoning_effort = "low"

[features.multi_agent_v2]
enabled = true
hide_spawn_agent_metadata = false

[model_providers.local-fixture]
name = "Local Fixture"
base_url = "{responses_base_url}"
wire_api = "responses"
requires_openai_auth = false
supports_websockets = false

contains_all: Task name for the new agent
Optional number of turns to fork
